integrity: Proof and independent finite checks use the explicit five axioms from the cited literature. This result has not undergone independent human or external audit.
scientific_limitations: All labeled preconditional operations on the specified rank-two atom lattices are counted, not isomorphism classes; stronger T/F-algebra restrictions are not covered. Earlier four-element Boolean count is recovered only as a check. General formulas proved symbolically, with independent finite enumeration through four atoms. Unindexed prior coverage remains possible.
title: Exact preconditional spectra of finite rank-two atom lattices
